title: SpendCapsConfig
description: config/spend_caps.yaml: the live-model spend caps and the per-uid rate limit (SEC-16, PRD supplement 4; FR-MTR-04, PRD 14.1, 17.3), read by tilo-api's spend loader. Money is an integer in INR minor units (paise, 1 INR = 100): never a float, a bool or a string. Every key is required and no other key is allowed; only org_day_minor may be null (ADR-0002 decision 13). The schema checks each value alone. Two rules it cannot express: a whole float such as 1000.0 is the same JSON number as 1000, so the loader also requires a YAML integer; and the shipped file keeps run_minor <= uid_lifetime_minor <= global_day_hard_minor. These caps sit beside config/metering.yaml (credits and US dollars) and replace none of it (ADR-0002 decision 16).

currency.description: The currency of every amount here: INR only (SEC-16). Another currency needs its own decision.

uid_lifetime_minor.description: Lifetime live-model spend per signed-in uid, in paise, above zero and never null (SEC-16: 1,000 INR).

run_minor.description: Live-model spend per run, in paise, above zero and never null (PRD 14.1, FR-MTR-04).

org_day_minor.description: Live-model spend per org per UTC day, in paise, above zero, or null for no separate per-org cap (as BQ-42 decided for credits); the key is required even when null.

global_day_hard_minor.description: The whole deployment's live-model spend per UTC day, in paise, above zero and never null; reaching it switches the link to replay-only (NFR-24, PRD 17.3).

rate_limit_requests.description: Requests one uid may make within one sliding window (SEC-16), above zero.

rate_limit_window_s.description: The length of the per-uid rate-limit window in seconds, above zero.
